title: Sports — July 2026 Highlights
summary: **2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup (England):** Australia beat England by 7 wickets (Australia's 7th title); POTT: Beth Mooney.

items: **2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup (England):** Australia beat England by 7 wickets (Australia's 7th title); POTT: Beth Mooney.
**Wimbledon 2026 (139th):** Men's — Jannik Sinner (5th Slam, 2nd consecutive Wimbledon, 100th Slam-match win) bt Zverev; Women's — Linda Nosková bt Muchová.
**FIFA World Cup 2026:** Spain bt Argentina, final at New York/New Jersey; Golden Boot: Mbappé; Golden Ball: Rodri; Spain = first nation to hold men's + women's World Cup simultaneously.
**PV Sindhu wins BWF Japan Open** — first Indian to win this title.
**IAF ranked World's 3rd Strongest Air Force** (WDMMA 2026) — after USAF, Russia; ahead of China.
